Marketplace sales are operationally complex: pricing, contracting, billing, revenue recognition, and compliance all intersect across multiple cloud providers. Suger removes this complexity with an API-first revenue platform that powers quote-to-cash and marketplace workflows at scale. Launched in 2022, Suger works with over 250 B2B customers, from large enterprises like Snowflake and Intel to fast-growing startups like Glean and Vanta. We're a Series A company backed by Threshold VC, Craft Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator. We're expanding Suger's platform with AI-powered agents and infrastructure that automate and optimize complex enterprise workflows across pricing, contracting, billing, and compliance. These systems sit at the core of customer revenue operations, where correctness, reliability, and scale matter deeply. This is not experimental AI at the edges - it's production infrastructure that must be explainable, resilient, and trusted. About the Role We're looking for a curious and driven Software Engineer Intern to join our engineering team in Vancouver. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teammates, working on meaningful projects that have a real impact on our product and customers. This internship offers students a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience building real products in a supportive, fast-paced environment. Interns will work closely with our team and contribute to meaningful projects throughout the program. This is a 4- month internship running from May 11 to August 28. Job Type: Full-time Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid - 4 days in office) Eligibility: • Currently pursuing or graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in 2026 • Authorized to work and reside in Canada • Available to work full-time for the duration of the internship Able and excited to work in person with our Vancouver team four days per week • Compensation: $18.75-$25 CAD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications In this role, you'll: Collaborate with engineers to design, build, test, and ship new software features • • Write clean, maintainable code and actively participate in code reviews • • Debug issues and help improve system performance, scalability, and reliability Contribute to technical documentation and internal tooling that supports the team • Learn quickly and grow with guidance and mentorship from experienced engineers We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
